verses.kjv: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.decoded: From the very start, the Word existed; the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

verses.kjv: The same was in the beginning with God.
verses.decoded: The Word was present with God from the beginning.

verses.kjv: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.
verses.decoded: Everything was created through him; nothing came into existence without him.

verses.kjv: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.
verses.decoded: In him was life, and that life was the light that shines for all people.

verses.kjv: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
verses.decoded: The light shines in the darkness, but the darkness has not understood or overcome it.

verses.kjv: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.
verses.decoded: God sent a man named John.

verses.kjv: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.
verses.decoded: He came to testify about the Light so that everyone might believe through him.

verses.kjv: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.
verses.decoded: He himself was not the Light, but was sent to testify about the Light.

verses.kjv: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.
verses.decoded: The true Light, which gives light to everyone, was coming into the world.

verses.kjv: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.
verses.decoded: He was in the world, which was created through him, but the world did not recognize him.

verses.kjv: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.
verses.decoded: He came to his own people, but they did not accept him.

verses.kjv: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:
verses.decoded: But to all who accepted him, he gave the right to become children of God—those who believe in his name.

verses.kjv: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
verses.decoded: They were born not by natural descent, human decision, or a husband’s choice, but by God.

verses.kjv: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
verses.decoded: The Word became human and lived among us. We saw his glory—the glory of the Father’s only Son—full of grace and truth.

verses.kjv: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.
verses.decoded: John testified about him, shouting, “This is the one I was talking about—the one who comes after me is greater than I am because he existed before me.”

verses.kjv: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.
verses.decoded: From his fullness we have all received grace upon grace.

verses.kjv: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.
verses.decoded: Moses gave the law, but grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.
verses.decoded: No one has ever seen God, but the only Son, who is close to the Father, has made him known.

verses.kjv: And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?
verses.decoded: This is John’s testimony when the Jewish leaders sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”

verses.kjv: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.
verses.decoded: John admitted it openly and did not deny it: “I am not the Messiah.”

verses.kjv: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.
verses.decoded: They asked him, “Then who are you? Are you Elijah?” He said, “No.” “Are you the Prophet?” He answered, “No.”

verses.kjv: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?
verses.decoded: So they asked him, “Who are you? Tell us so we can give an answer to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”

verses.kjv: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.
verses.decoded: He replied, “I am the voice calling out in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord,’ as the prophet Isaiah said.”

verses.kjv: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.
verses.decoded: The people who had been sent were Pharisees.

verses.kjv: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?
verses.decoded: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Messiah, Elijah, or the Prophet?”

verses.kjv: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;
verses.decoded: John answered, “I baptize with water, but there is someone among you whom you do not know.”

verses.kjv: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe's latchet I am not worthy to unloose.
verses.decoded: He is the one who comes after me and is greater than I am—I am not even worthy to untie his sandals.

verses.kjv: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.
verses.decoded: This all happened at Bethany across the Jordan River, where John was baptizing.

verses.kjv: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.
verses.decoded: The next day, John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, “Look, the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!”

verses.kjv: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.
verses.decoded: This is the one I was talking about when I said, ‘A man who comes after me is greater than I am because he existed before me.’

verses.kjv: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.
verses.decoded: I did not know him before, but I came baptizing with water so that he might be revealed to Israel.

verses.kjv: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.
verses.decoded: John testified, “I saw the Spirit come down from heaven like a dove and rest on him.”

verses.kjv: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.
verses.decoded: I did not know him before, but the one who sent me to baptize with water told me, ‘The one on whom you see the Spirit come down and stay is the one who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.’

verses.kjv: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.
verses.decoded: I saw it and testified that this is the Son of God.

verses.kjv: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;
verses.decoded: The next day, John was standing there again with two of his disciples.

verses.kjv: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!
verses.decoded: When he saw Jesus walking by, he said, “Look, the Lamb of God!”

verses.kjv: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
verses.decoded: The two disciples heard him say this and began to follow Jesus.

verses.kjv: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?
verses.decoded: Jesus turned around, saw them following, and asked, “What do you want?” They said, “Teacher, where are you staying?”

verses.kjv: He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.
verses.decoded: He told them, “Come and see.” So they went with him and stayed that day because it was about 4 p.m.

verses.kjv: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.
verses.decoded: One of the two who heard John and followed Jesus was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

verses.kjv: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.
verses.decoded: Andrew first found his brother Simon and told him, “We have found the Messiah” (which means Christ).

verses.kjv: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.
verses.decoded: Then Andrew brought Simon to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon, son of Jonah; you will be called Cephas” (which means Peter).

verses.kjv: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.
verses.decoded: The next day Jesus decided to go to Galilee. He found Philip and said, “Follow me.”

verses.kjv: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
verses.decoded: Philip was from Bethsaida, the same town as Andrew and Peter.

verses.kjv: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.
verses.decoded: Philip found Nathanael and told him, “We have found the one Moses and the prophets wrote about—Jesus of Nazareth, Joseph’s son.”

verses.kjv: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.
verses.decoded: Nathanael asked, “Can anything good come from Nazareth?” Philip replied, “Come and see.”

verses.kjv: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!
verses.decoded: Jesus saw Nathanael approaching and said, “Here is a true Israelite, a man without deceit.”

verses.kjv: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.
verses.decoded: Nathanael asked, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered, “I saw you earlier under the fig tree before Philip called you.”

verses.kjv: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.
verses.decoded: Nathanael replied, “Teacher, you are the Son of God; you are the King of Israel.”

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, “You believe because I told you I saw you under the fig tree? You will see even greater things than this.”

verses.kjv: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, “Truly, truly, I tell you, from now on you will see heaven open and God’s angels going up and down on the Son of Man.”

verses.kjv: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:
verses.decoded: On the third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee, and Jesus’ mother was there.

verses.kjv: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.
verses.decoded: Jesus and his disciples were also invited to the wedding.

verses.kjv: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.
verses.decoded: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother told him, “They have no more wine.”

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.
verses.decoded: Jesus replied, “Woman, why do you involve me? My time has not yet come.”

verses.kjv: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.
verses.decoded: His mother told the servants, “Do whatever he tells you.”

verses.kjv: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.
verses.decoded: Nearby were six stone water jars used for Jewish purification rituals, each holding about 20 to 30 gallons.

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.
verses.decoded: Jesus told them, “Fill the jars with water.” So they filled them to the top.

verses.kjv: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it.
verses.decoded: Then he said, “Now draw some out and take it to the master of the banquet.” They did as he said.

verses.kjv: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,
verses.decoded: The master of the banquet tasted the water that had become wine, not knowing where it came from (though the servants who drew the water knew). He called the bridegroom.

verses.kjv: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.
verses.decoded: He said, “Usually the best wine is served first, and after people have drunk freely, the cheaper wine is served. But you have saved the best wine until now.”

verses.kjv: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
verses.decoded: This was the first miracle Jesus performed in Cana of Galilee, revealing his glory, and his disciples believed in him.

verses.kjv: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.
verses.decoded: After this, Jesus went down to Capernaum with his mother, brothers, and disciples, and stayed there only a few days.

verses.kjv: And the Jews' passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,
verses.decoded: The Jewish Passover was near, so Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:
verses.decoded: In the temple, he found people selling oxen, sheep, and doves, and money changers sitting there.

verses.kjv: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers' money, and overthrew the tables;
verses.decoded: Jesus made a whip from cords and drove all of them out of the temple, including the sheep and oxen. He scattered the money changers’ coins and overturned their tables.

verses.kjv: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father's house an house of merchandise.
verses.decoded: He told those selling doves, “Take these things away; don’t turn my Father’s house into a marketplace.”

verses.kjv: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.
verses.decoded: His disciples remembered the scripture that says, “Zeal for your house will consume me.”

verses.kjv: Then answered the Jews and said unto him, What sign shewest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?
verses.decoded: The Jewish leaders asked him, “What proof can you show us to justify what you are doing?”

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.
verses.decoded: Jesus replied, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”

verses.kjv: Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?
verses.decoded: The Jews said, “It took 46 years to build this temple, and you will raise it up in three days?”

verses.kjv: But he spake of the temple of his body.
verses.decoded: But Jesus was speaking about the temple of his body.

verses.kjv: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.
verses.decoded: After he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered what he had said and believed both the scripture and Jesus’ words.

verses.kjv: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.
verses.decoded: During the Passover festival in Jerusalem, many believed in Jesus’ name when they saw the miracles he performed.

verses.kjv: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men,
verses.decoded: But Jesus did not trust them because he knew what was in everyone’s heart.

verses.kjv: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.
verses.decoded: He didn’t need anyone to tell him about people because he already knew what was inside them.

verses.kjv: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:
verses.decoded: There was a Pharisee named Nicodemus, a Jewish leader.

verses.kjv: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.
verses.decoded: He came to Jesus at night and said, “Teacher, we know you are from God because no one could perform these miracles unless God is with him.”

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
verses.decoded: Jesus replied, “Truly, I tell you, no one can see God’s kingdom unless they are born again.”

verses.kjv: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?
verses.decoded: Nicodemus asked, “How can someone be born again when they are old? Can they enter their mother’s womb a second time and be born?”

verses.kjv: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, “Truly, I tell you, no one can enter God’s kingdom unless they are born of water and the Spirit.”

verses.kjv: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
verses.decoded: What is born from human parents is human, but what is born from the Spirit is spiritual.

verses.kjv: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.
verses.decoded: Don’t be surprised when I say you must be born again.

verses.kjv: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
verses.decoded: The wind blows wherever it wants, and you hear its sound but don’t know where it comes from or where it’s going. That’s how it is with everyone born of the Spirit.

verses.kjv: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?
verses.decoded: Nicodemus asked, “How can this happen?”

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?
verses.decoded: Jesus replied, “You are a teacher of Israel, and yet you don’t understand these things?”

verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.
verses.decoded: Truly, I tell you, we speak about what we know and testify to what we have seen, but you don’t accept our testimony.

verses.kjv: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?
verses.decoded: If you don’t believe me when I talk about earthly things, how will you believe when I talk about heavenly things?

verses.kjv: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.
verses.decoded: No one has gone up to heaven except the one who came down from heaven—the Son of Man who is in heaven.

verses.kjv: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:
verses.decoded: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up.

verses.kjv: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
verses.decoded: So that everyone who believes in him will not die but have eternal life.

verses.kjv: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
verses.decoded: God loved the world so much that he gave his only Son, so that whoever believes in him will not die but have eternal life.

verses.kjv: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
verses.decoded: God did not send his Son to judge the world, but to save the world through him.

verses.kjv: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.
verses.decoded: Whoever believes in him is not judged guilty, but whoever does not believe is already judged guilty because they have not believed in God’s only Son.

verses.kjv: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.
verses.decoded: This is the judgment: the light has come into the world, but people loved darkness instead of light because their actions were evil.

verses.kjv: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.
verses.decoded: Everyone who does evil hates the light and avoids it because they don’t want their actions exposed.

verses.kjv: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.
verses.decoded: But anyone who lives by the truth comes to the light so that it may be clear that their actions are done through God.

verses.kjv: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.
verses.decoded: After this, Jesus and his disciples went into Judea, where he stayed and baptized people.

verses.kjv: And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.
verses.decoded: John was also baptizing at Aenon near Salim because there was plenty of water, and people were coming to be baptized.

verses.kjv: For John was not yet cast into prison.
verses.decoded: This was before John was put in prison.

verses.kjv: Then there arose a question between some of John's disciples and the Jews about purifying.
verses.decoded: Some of John’s disciples and a group of Jews began arguing about ceremonial washing.

verses.kjv: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.
verses.decoded: They came to John and said, “Teacher, the man you testified about who was beyond the Jordan is now baptizing, and everyone is going to him.”

verses.kjv: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.
verses.decoded: John answered, “No one can receive anything unless it is given from heaven.”

verses.kjv: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.
verses.decoded: You yourselves can confirm that I said, ‘I am not the Messiah, but I have been sent ahead of him.’

verses.kjv: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.
verses.decoded: The bride belongs to the bridegroom, but the friend of the bridegroom who stands and listens is filled with joy because of the bridegroom’s voice. This is why my joy is complete.

verses.kjv: He must increase, but I must decrease.
verses.decoded: He must become greater, and I must become less.

verses.kjv: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.
verses.decoded: The one who comes from above is greater than everyone. The one who belongs to the earth speaks about earthly things, but the one who comes from heaven is above all.

verses.kjv: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.
verses.decoded: He testifies about what he has seen and heard, but no one accepts his testimony.

verses.kjv: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.
verses.decoded: Whoever accepts his testimony confirms that God is truthful.

verses.kjv: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.
verses.decoded: The one God sends speaks God’s words because God gives the Spirit fully to him without limit.

verses.kjv: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.
verses.decoded: The Father loves the Son and has given him complete authority.

verses.kjv: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.
verses.decoded: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life, but whoever does not believe in the Son will not see life, and God’s judgment remains on them.

verses.kjv: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,
verses.decoded: When the Lord realized that the Pharisees heard Jesus was making and baptizing more followers than John,

verses.kjv: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)
verses.decoded: although Jesus himself did not baptize, only his followers did,

verses.kjv: He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.
verses.decoded: he left Judea and went back to Galilee.

verses.kjv: And he must needs go through Samaria.
verses.decoded: He had to go through Samaria on the way.

verses.kjv: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
verses.decoded: He came to a city in Samaria called Sychar, near the land Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

verses.kjv: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
verses.decoded: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus was tired from traveling, so he sat down by the well around noon.

verses.kjv: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.
verses.decoded: A Samaritan woman came to get water, and Jesus asked her, 'Please give me a drink.'

verses.kjv: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)
verses.decoded: His followers had gone into the city to buy food.

verses.kjv: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.
verses.decoded: The woman said, 'How can you, a Jew, ask me, a Samaritan woman, for a drink? Jews don’t share with Samaritans.'

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'If you knew the gift God gives and who is asking you for a drink, you would ask him, and he would give you living water.'

verses.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?
verses.decoded: The woman said, 'Sir, you have nothing to get water with, and the well is deep. Where would you get this living water?'

verses.kjv: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?
verses.decoded: She asked, 'Are you greater than our ancestor Jacob, who gave us this well and drank from it himself, along with his children and animals?'

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'Anyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again,'

verses.kjv: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
verses.decoded: but anyone who drinks the water I give will never be thirsty again. That water will become a spring inside them, giving eternal life.'

verses.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.
verses.decoded: The woman said, 'Sir, please give me this water so I won’t be thirsty or have to keep coming here to get water.'

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'Go get your husband and come back.'

verses.kjv: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:
verses.decoded: The woman said, 'I don’t have a husband.' Jesus said, 'You’re right; you don’t have a husband,'

verses.kjv: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.
verses.decoded: because you have had five husbands, and the man you live with now is not your husband. You told the truth.'

verses.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.
verses.decoded: The woman said, 'Sir, I can tell you are a prophet.'

verses.kjv: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.
verses.decoded: She said, 'Our ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you say people should worship in Jerusalem.'

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.
verses.decoded: Jesus told her, Woman, believe me, a time is coming when you will not worship the Father on this mountain or in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.
verses.decoded: You worship something you don't understand; we know what we worship because salvation comes from the Jews.

verses.kjv: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.
verses.decoded: But the time is coming, and it is now, when true worshippers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, because the Father wants people like that to worship Him.

verses.kjv: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.
verses.decoded: God is a Spirit, so those who worship Him must worship in spirit and truth.

verses.kjv: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.
verses.decoded: The woman said to him, I know the Messiah is coming, who is called Christ; when he comes, he will explain everything to us.

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to her, I am the one speaking to you.

verses.kjv: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?
verses.decoded: At that moment, his disciples came and were surprised that he was talking with a woman, but no one asked why or what he wanted.

verses.kjv: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,
verses.decoded: The woman left her water jar and went into the city, telling the people there,

verses.kjv: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?
verses.decoded: Come see a man who told me everything I ever did; could this be the Christ?

verses.kjv: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.
verses.decoded: Then they left the city and went to him.

verses.kjv: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.
verses.decoded: Meanwhile, his disciples urged him, Master, please eat something.

verses.kjv: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.
verses.decoded: But he told them, I have food to eat that you don't know about.

verses.kjv: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?
verses.decoded: The disciples asked each other, Did someone bring him food?

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, My food is to do the will of the one who sent me and to finish his work.

verses.kjv: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.
verses.decoded: Don't say there are still four months until harvest; look up and see the fields—they are ready to be harvested now.

verses.kjv: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.
verses.decoded: The one who harvests receives payment and gathers fruit for eternal life, so both the one who plants and the one who harvests can be happy together.

verses.kjv: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.
verses.decoded: This saying is true: one plants, and another harvests.

verses.kjv: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.
verses.decoded: I sent you to harvest what you did not work for; others worked, and you are sharing their work.

verses.kjv: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.
verses.decoded: Many Samaritans from that city believed in him because of the woman's testimony that he told her everything she ever did.

verses.kjv: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.
verses.decoded: When the Samaritans came to him, they asked him to stay with them, and he stayed there two days.

verses.kjv: And many more believed because of his own word;
verses.decoded: Many more people believed because of what Jesus said.

verses.kjv: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.
verses.decoded: They told the woman, 'Now we believe, not just because of what you said, but because we heard Jesus ourselves and know that he is truly the Christ, the Savior of the world.'

verses.kjv: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.
verses.decoded: After two days, Jesus left there and went to Galilee.

verses.kjv: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.
verses.decoded: Jesus said that a prophet is not honored in his own hometown.

verses.kjv: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
verses.decoded: When Jesus arrived in Galilee, the people there welcomed him because they had seen the things he did in Jerusalem at the feast, since they also went to the feast.

verses.kjv: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.
verses.decoded: Jesus went back to Cana in Galilee, where he had turned water into wine. There was a nobleman whose son was very sick in Capernaum.

verses.kjv: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.
verses.decoded: When the nobleman heard that Jesus had come from Judea to Galilee, he went to Jesus and begged him to come and heal his son because the boy was about to die.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to him, 'Unless you see signs and miracles, you will not believe.'

verses.kjv: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.
verses.decoded: The nobleman said, 'Sir, please come down before my child dies.'

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.
verses.decoded: Jesus told him, 'Go home; your son is alive.' The man believed what Jesus said and went home.

verses.kjv: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.
verses.decoded: While he was going home, his servants met him and said, 'Your son is alive.'

verses.kjv: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
verses.decoded: He asked them when his son started to get better. They said, 'Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.'

verses.kjv: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.
verses.decoded: The father realized that this happened at the exact time Jesus said, 'Your son is alive.' He believed, and so did his whole family.

verses.kjv: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.
verses.decoded: This was the second miracle Jesus did after coming from Judea to Galilee.

verses.kjv: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: After this, there was a Jewish festival, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.
verses.decoded: Near the sheep market in Jerusalem, there was a pool called Bethesda in Hebrew, which had five covered walkways.

verses.kjv: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.
verses.decoded: Many sick people were lying there—blind, lame, and withered—waiting for the water to move.

verses.kjv: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.
verses.decoded: An angel would come down at certain times and stir the water. The first person to step in after the water was stirred would be healed from whatever disease they had.

verses.kjv: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.
verses.decoded: There was a man there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.

verses.kjv: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?
verses.decoded: When Jesus saw him lying there and knew he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, 'Do you want to get well?'

verses.kjv: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.
verses.decoded: The sick man said to Jesus, 'Sir, I have no one to help me into the pool when the water moves, and while I try, someone else goes in before me.'

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.
verses.decoded: Jesus told him, 'Get up, pick up your bed, and walk.'

verses.kjv: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.
verses.decoded: Right away, the man was healed, he picked up his bed, and walked. That same day was the Sabbath.

verses.kjv: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.
verses.decoded: The Jewish leaders said to the man who was healed, 'It is the Sabbath, and you are not allowed to carry your bed.'

verses.kjv: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.
verses.decoded: He answered them, 'The one who healed me told me to pick up my bed and walk.'

verses.kjv: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?
verses.decoded: They asked him, 'Who is the man that told you to pick up your bed and walk?'

verses.kjv: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.
verses.decoded: The man did not know who it was because Jesus had slipped away while many people were there.

verses.kjv: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.
verses.decoded: Later, Jesus found him in the temple and said, 'Look, you are healed. Don't sin anymore, or something worse might happen to you.'

verses.kjv: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.
verses.decoded: The man went away and told the Jewish leaders that Jesus was the one who healed him.

verses.kjv: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.
verses.decoded: Because Jesus healed on the Sabbath, the Jewish leaders began to persecute him and wanted to kill him.

verses.kjv: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered them, 'My Father is working until now, and I am working too.'

verses.kjv: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.
verses.decoded: So the Jewish leaders wanted to kill him even more because he broke the Sabbath and said God was his Father, making himself equal to God.

verses.kjv: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to them, 'I tell you the truth, the Son can do nothing by himself. He only does what he sees the Father doing. Whatever the Father does, the Son does too.'

verses.kjv: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.
verses.decoded: The Father loves the Son and shows him everything he does. The Father will show him even greater things so you will be amazed.

verses.kjv: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.
verses.decoded: Just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, the Son also gives life to anyone he wants.

verses.kjv: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:
verses.decoded: The Father does not judge anyone but has given all judgment to the Son.

verses.kjv: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.
verses.decoded: Everyone should honor the Son just like they honor the Father. If someone does not honor the Son, they do not honor the Father who sent him.

verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.
verses.decoded: I tell you the truth, anyone who hears my words and believes in the one who sent me has eternal life and will not be judged but has passed from death to life.

verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.
verses.decoded: I tell you the truth, the time is coming, and it is now, when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God and those who hear will live.

verses.kjv: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;
verses.decoded: Just as the Father has life in himself, he has given the Son to have life in himself.

verses.kjv: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.
verses.decoded: God has given him the power to judge people because he is the Son of Man.

verses.kjv: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,
verses.decoded: Don't be surprised by this, because a time is coming when everyone who is dead will hear his voice.

verses.kjv: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.
verses.decoded: They will come out of their graves; those who did good will be raised to live, and those who did evil will be raised to be judged.

verses.kjv: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.
verses.decoded: I can't do anything by myself; I judge based on what I hear, and my judgment is fair because I don't want my own way but the Father's will who sent me.

verses.kjv: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
verses.decoded: If I testify about myself, my testimony is not true.

verses.kjv: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.
verses.decoded: There is someone else who testifies about me, and I know his testimony about me is true.

verses.kjv: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.
verses.decoded: You sent people to John, and he testified to the truth.

verses.kjv: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.
verses.decoded: But I don't accept human testimony; I say these things so that you may be saved.

verses.kjv: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.
verses.decoded: John was like a burning and shining light, and for a while, you were happy to follow his light.

verses.kjv: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.
verses.decoded: But I have a greater witness than John's because the works the Father gave me to do show that the Father sent me.

verses.kjv: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.
verses.decoded: The Father who sent me has also testified about me, but you have never heard his voice or seen what he looks like.

verses.kjv: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.
verses.decoded: You don't have God's word living in you because you don't believe in the one he sent.

verses.kjv: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.
verses.decoded: Look carefully at the scriptures because you think they give you eternal life, but they actually tell about me.

verses.kjv: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.
verses.decoded: But you refuse to come to me to have life.

verses.kjv: I receive not honour from men.
verses.decoded: I do not accept praise from people.

verses.kjv: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.
verses.decoded: But I know you do not have God's love in you.

verses.kjv: I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.
verses.decoded: I came in my Father's name, but you do not accept me; if someone else comes in their own name, you will accept them.

verses.kjv: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?
verses.decoded: How can you believe when you accept praise from each other but do not seek the praise that comes only from God?

verses.kjv: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.
verses.decoded: Don't think I will accuse you to the Father; Moses, whom you trust, will accuse you.

verses.kjv: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.
verses.decoded: If you really believed Moses, you would believe me because he wrote about me.

verses.kjv: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?
verses.decoded: If you don't believe what the Scriptures say, how can you believe what I say?

verses.kjv: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.
verses.decoded: After that, Jesus crossed the Sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.

verses.kjv: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.
verses.decoded: A large crowd followed him because they saw the miracles he did by healing sick people.

verses.kjv: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.
verses.decoded: Jesus went up a mountain and sat down there with his followers.

verses.kjv: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.
verses.decoded: The Jewish Passover festival was coming soon.

verses.kjv: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?
verses.decoded: Jesus looked up and saw a large crowd coming to him. He asked Philip, 'Where can we buy bread for all these people to eat?'

verses.kjv: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.
verses.decoded: He asked Philip this to test him, because Jesus already knew what he was going to do.

verses.kjv: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.
verses.decoded: Philip said, 'Even 200 coins worth of bread wouldn't be enough for everyone to have a little.'

verses.kjv: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, saith unto him,
verses.decoded: One of Jesus' followers, Andrew, who was Simon Peter's brother, said to him,

verses.kjv: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
verses.decoded: 'There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two small fish, but how can that feed so many people?'

verses.kjv: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
verses.decoded: Jesus told the people to sit down. There was a lot of grass there, so about five thousand men sat down.

verses.kjv: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.
verses.decoded: Jesus took the loaves, gave thanks, and gave them to his disciples to distribute to the people. He did the same with the fish, giving as much as they wanted.

verses.kjv: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.
verses.decoded: After everyone was full, Jesus told his disciples, 'Gather the leftovers so nothing is wasted.'

verses.kjv: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.
verses.decoded: They collected the leftovers and filled twelve baskets with pieces of the five barley loaves that were left over.

verses.kjv: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.
verses.decoded: When the people saw the miracle Jesus did, they said, 'This must be the prophet who is coming into the world.'

verses.kjv: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.
verses.decoded: Jesus realized they wanted to force him to be king, so he went away alone to a mountain.

verses.kjv: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,
verses.decoded: When evening came, Jesus' disciples went down to the sea.

verses.kjv: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.
verses.decoded: They got into a boat and started crossing the sea toward Capernaum. It was dark, and Jesus had not yet joined them.

verses.kjv: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.
verses.decoded: A strong wind caused the sea to become rough.

verses.kjv: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.
verses.decoded: After rowing about three to four miles, they saw Jesus walking on the water toward the boat, and they were afraid.

verses.kjv: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to them, "It is me; don't be afraid."

verses.kjv: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.
verses.decoded: They gladly let him get into the boat, and right away the boat reached the land they were going to.

verses.kjv: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;
verses.decoded: The next day, the people on the other side of the sea saw that only one boat was there—the one the disciples had entered—and that Jesus had not gone with them, but the disciples had left alone.

verses.kjv: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)
verses.decoded: Other boats came from Tiberias near the place where they had eaten bread after the Lord gave thanks.

verses.kjv: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.
verses.decoded: When the people saw that Jesus and his disciples were not there, they got boats and went to Capernaum to look for Jesus.

verses.kjv: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?
verses.decoded: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they said, "Teacher, when did you get here?"

verses.kjv: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, "I tell you the truth, you are looking for me not because you saw miracles, but because you ate the bread and were filled."

verses.kjv: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.
verses.decoded: Don't work for food that will spoil, but work for food that lasts forever, which the Son of Man will give you. God the Father has approved him.

verses.kjv: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?
verses.decoded: They asked him, "What should we do to do the works God wants?"

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, "The work God wants is for you to believe in the one he sent."

verses.kjv: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?
verses.decoded: They said, "What miracle will you show us so we can believe you? What will you do?"

verses.kjv: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.
verses.decoded: Our ancestors ate manna in the desert, as it is written, 'He gave them bread from heaven to eat.'

verses.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, "I tell you the truth, Moses did not give you that bread from heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread from heaven."

verses.kjv: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.
verses.decoded: The bread of God is the one who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.

verses.kjv: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.
verses.decoded: They said, "Lord, always give us this bread."

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, "I am the bread of life. Anyone who comes to me will never be hungry, and anyone who believes in me will never be thirsty."

verses.kjv: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.
verses.decoded: But I told you that you have seen me and still do not believe.

verses.kjv: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.
verses.decoded: Everyone the Father gives me will come to me, and I will never reject anyone who comes to me.

verses.kjv: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.
verses.decoded: I came down from heaven not to do my own will, but the will of the one who sent me.

verses.kjv: And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.
verses.decoded: The Father who sent me wants me to keep safe everyone he gave me and raise them up on the last day.

verses.kjv: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.decoded: This is what God wants: that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him will have eternal life. I will raise them up on the last day.

verses.kjv: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.
verses.decoded: The Jewish people complained about him because he said, 'I am the bread that came down from heaven.'

verses.kjv: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?
verses.decoded: They said, 'Isn't this Jesus, the son of Joseph? We know his parents. How can he say he came down from heaven?'

verses.kjv: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered them, 'Don't complain to each other like that.'

verses.kjv: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.decoded: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws them. I will raise them up on the last day.

verses.kjv: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.
verses.decoded: The prophets wrote, 'Everyone will be taught by God.' So, anyone who has heard and learned from the Father comes to me.

verses.kjv: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.
verses.decoded: No one has seen the Father except the one who is from God; only he has seen the Father.

verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.
verses.decoded: I tell you the truth, anyone who believes in me has eternal life.

verses.kjv: I am that bread of life.
verses.decoded: I am the bread of life.

verses.kjv: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.
verses.decoded: Your ancestors ate manna in the desert, but they died.

verses.kjv: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.
verses.decoded: This is the bread that comes down from heaven so that anyone who eats it will not die.

verses.kjv: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.
verses.decoded: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. Anyone who eats this bread will live forever. The bread I give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

verses.kjv: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?
verses.decoded: The Jewish people argued among themselves, saying, 'How can this man give us his flesh to eat?'

verses.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to them, 'I tell you the truth, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you have no life in you.'

verses.kjv: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.decoded: Anyone who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise them up on the last day.

verses.kjv: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
verses.decoded: My flesh is true food, and my blood is true drink.

verses.kjv: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.
verses.decoded: Anyone who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I live in them.

verses.kjv: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.
verses.decoded: Just as the living Father sent me and I live because of the Father, anyone who eats me will live because of me.

verses.kjv: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.
verses.decoded: This is the bread that came down from heaven. Your ancestors ate manna and died, but anyone who eats this bread will live forever.

verses.kjv: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
verses.decoded: Jesus said these things while teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum.

verses.kjv: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?
verses.decoded: Many of Jesus' followers said this teaching was too hard to understand and asked who could accept it.

verses.kjv: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?
verses.decoded: Jesus knew they were complaining, so he asked if what he said upset them.

verses.kjv: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?
verses.decoded: He asked, 'What if you see me, the Son of Man, go back to where I was before?'

verses.kjv: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.
verses.decoded: The Spirit gives life; the body alone can't help. The words I say to you are spirit and life.

verses.kjv: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.
verses.decoded: Some of you do not believe. Jesus knew from the start who did not believe and who would betray him.

verses.kjv: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.
verses.decoded: He said, 'That's why I told you no one can come to me unless my Father allows it.'

verses.kjv: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
verses.decoded: After that, many of his followers stopped following him.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?
verses.decoded: Jesus asked the twelve disciples, 'Are you going to leave too?'

verses.kjv: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
verses.decoded: Simon Peter answered, 'Lord, where else can we go? You have the words that give eternal life.'

verses.kjv: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.
verses.decoded: We believe and are sure that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.

verses.kjv: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'Didn't I choose you twelve? But one of you is a devil.'

verses.kjv: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
verses.decoded: He was talking about Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, who would betray him even though he was one of the twelve.

verses.kjv: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.
verses.decoded: After this, Jesus stayed in Galilee because he did not want to go to Judea since the Jews there wanted to kill him.

verses.kjv: Now the Jews' feast of tabernacles was at hand.
verses.decoded: The Jewish Feast of Tabernacles was coming soon.

verses.kjv: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.
verses.decoded: His brothers told him, 'Leave here and go to Judea so your followers can see the miracles you do.'

verses.kjv: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.
verses.decoded: They said, 'No one does things in secret if they want to be known. If you do these things, show yourself to the world.'

verses.kjv: For neither did his brethren believe in him.
verses.decoded: Even his brothers did not believe in him.

verses.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'My time has not come yet, but your time is always ready.'

verses.kjv: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'The world does not hate you, but it hates me because I tell the truth about its evil ways.'

verses.kjv: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.
verses.decoded: Jesus told them, 'Go to the feast, but I am not going yet because my time has not come.'

verses.kjv: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.
verses.decoded: After saying these things to them, Jesus stayed in Galilee.

verses.kjv: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.
verses.decoded: But after his brothers went to the feast, he also went, but quietly and not openly.

verses.kjv: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?
verses.decoded: The Jewish people looked for him at the feast and asked, 'Where is he?'

verses.kjv: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.
verses.decoded: Many people were talking about him: some said he was a good man, others said he was tricking people.

verses.kjv: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.
verses.decoded: But no one spoke openly about him because they were afraid of the Jewish leaders.

verses.kjv: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.
verses.decoded: About halfway through the feast, Jesus went to the temple and taught.

verses.kjv: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?
verses.decoded: The Jewish people were amazed and asked, 'How does this man know so much without being taught?'

verses.kjv: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'My teaching is not from me, but from the one who sent me.'

verses.kjv: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.
verses.decoded: If anyone wants to do God's will, they will understand if my teaching is from God or if I speak on my own.

verses.kjv: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
verses.decoded: Anyone who speaks on their own wants their own glory, but the one who seeks the glory of the one who sent him is truthful and has no wrong in him.

verses.kjv: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?
verses.decoded: Didn’t Moses give you the law, but none of you follow it? So why are you trying to kill me?

verses.kjv: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?
verses.decoded: The people said, 'You have a demon! Who is trying to kill you?'

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'I did one work, and you are all amazed.'

verses.kjv: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.
verses.decoded: Moses gave you circumcision, not because Moses made it, but because of your ancestors; and you circumcise a man on the Sabbath day.

verses.kjv: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?
verses.decoded: If a man can be circumcised on the Sabbath to keep Moses' law, why are you angry with me for healing a man completely on the Sabbath?

verses.kjv: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
verses.decoded: Don't judge by what you see on the outside, but judge fairly.

verses.kjv: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?
verses.decoded: Some people from Jerusalem said, 'Isn't this the man they want to kill?'

verses.kjv: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?
verses.decoded: But look, he speaks boldly, and no one says anything to him. Do the leaders really know that this is the Christ?

verses.kjv: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.
verses.decoded: We know where this man is from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he is from.

verses.kjv: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.
verses.decoded: Jesus shouted in the temple while teaching, 'You know me and where I am from, but I did not come on my own. The one who sent me is true, but you do not know him.'

verses.kjv: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.
verses.decoded: But I know God because I come from Him, and He sent me.

verses.kjv: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.
verses.decoded: They tried to arrest Jesus, but no one grabbed Him because it was not yet the right time.

verses.kjv: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?
verses.decoded: Many people believed in Jesus and said, 'When the Messiah comes, will he do more miracles than this man has?'

verses.kjv: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.
verses.decoded: The Pharisees heard the people talking about Jesus like this, so they and the chief priests sent officers to arrest Him.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.
verses.decoded: Jesus told them, 'I will only be with you a little longer, then I will go to the one who sent me.'

verses.kjv: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.
verses.decoded: You will look for me but will not find me, and you cannot come where I am going.

verses.kjv: Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?
verses.decoded: The Jews asked each other, 'Where will he go that we cannot find him? Will he go to the Jewish people living among the Gentiles and teach them?'

verses.kjv: What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come?
verses.decoded: They wondered what He meant by saying, 'You will look for me but will not find me, and you cannot come where I am going.'

verses.kjv: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.
verses.decoded: On the last and greatest day of the festival, Jesus stood up and said, 'If anyone is thirsty, let them come to me and drink.'

verses.kjv: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.
verses.decoded: Anyone who believes in me will have rivers of living water flowing from inside them, just like the scripture says.

verses.kjv: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)
verses.decoded: (Jesus was talking about the Holy Spirit, which those who believed in Him would receive later, because the Holy Spirit had not yet been given since Jesus was not yet glorified.)

verses.kjv: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.
verses.decoded: Many people who heard this said, 'Surely this man is the Prophet.'

verses.kjv: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?
verses.decoded: Others said, 'He is the Messiah.' But some asked, 'Does the Messiah come from Galilee?'

verses.kjv: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?
verses.decoded: The scripture says the Messiah comes from David’s family and from Bethlehem, the town where David lived.

verses.kjv: So there was a division among the people because of him.
verses.decoded: Because of Jesus, the people were divided into different groups.

verses.kjv: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.
verses.decoded: Some wanted to arrest Him, but no one grabbed Him.

verses.kjv: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?
verses.decoded: The officers went back to the chief priests and Pharisees and asked, 'Why didn’t you bring Him to us?'

verses.kjv: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.
verses.decoded: The officers said, 'No one has ever spoken like this man.'

verses.kjv: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?
verses.decoded: The Pharisees asked, 'Are you also fooled by Him?'

verses.kjv: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?
verses.decoded: They asked, 'Has any of the leaders or Pharisees believed in Him?'

verses.kjv: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.
verses.decoded: But these people who do not understand the law are under a curse.

verses.kjv: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)
verses.decoded: Nicodemus, who came to Jesus at night and was one of them, said to them,

verses.kjv: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?
verses.decoded: Does our law judge a person before it listens to them and knows what they have done?

verses.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.
verses.decoded: They answered him, Are you also from Galilee? Look and see, because no prophet comes from Galilee.

verses.kjv: And every man went unto his own house.
verses.decoded: Then everyone went to their own home.

verses.kjv: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.
verses.decoded: Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

verses.kjv: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.
verses.decoded: Early in the morning, Jesus went back to the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down and taught them.

verses.kjv: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,
verses.decoded: The teachers of the law and Pharisees brought a woman caught in the act of adultery to Jesus. They made her stand in the middle of the group.

verses.kjv: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.
verses.decoded: They said to Jesus, Teacher, this woman was caught in the very act of adultery.

verses.kjv: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?
verses.decoded: Moses gave us the law that says such a woman should be stoned. What do you say?

verses.kjv: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.
verses.decoded: They said this to test Jesus and find a reason to accuse him. But Jesus bent down and wrote on the ground with his finger, as if he did not hear them.

verses.kjv: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
verses.decoded: They kept asking Jesus, so he stood up and said, The one who has never sinned should be the first to throw a stone at her.

verses.kjv: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.
verses.decoded: Jesus bent down again and wrote on the ground.

verses.kjv: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.
verses.decoded: When they heard this, their own conscience made them feel guilty, so they left one by one, starting with the oldest. Jesus was left alone with the woman standing there.

verses.kjv: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?
verses.decoded: Jesus stood up and asked her, Woman, where are your accusers? Has no one condemned you?
