verses.kjv: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?
verses.decoded: Now I am going to the one who sent me, and none of you ask me where I am going.

verses.kjv: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.
verses.decoded: Because I told you this, you feel sad in your hearts.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.
verses.decoded: But I am telling you the truth: it is better for you that I go away. If I don't go, the Comforter won't come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.

verses.kjv: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
verses.decoded: When he comes, he will show the world that it is wrong about sin, right living, and judgment.

verses.kjv: Of sin, because they believe not on me;
verses.decoded: He will show them they are wrong about sin because they don't believe in me.

verses.kjv: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;
verses.decoded: He will show them they are right about living rightly because I am going to the Father, and you won't see me anymore.

verses.kjv: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.
verses.decoded: The world is judged because its leader has already been judged.

verses.kjv: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.
verses.decoded: I have many more things to tell you, but you can't understand them right now.

verses.kjv: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.
verses.decoded: But when the Spirit of truth comes, he will guide you to understand all truth. He won't speak on his own but will say what he hears and will tell you about the future.

verses.kjv: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
verses.decoded: He will honor me because he will receive from me and show it to you.

verses.kjv: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
verses.decoded: Everything the Father has belongs to me. That's why I said the Spirit will take from me and show it to you.

verses.kjv: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.
verses.decoded: Soon, you won't see me, but after a short time, you will see me again because I am going to the Father.

verses.kjv: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?
verses.decoded: Some of his followers asked each other what he meant by saying they wouldn't see him for a little while and then would see him again because he was going to the Father.

verses.kjv: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.
verses.decoded: They said, 'What does he mean by a little while? We don't understand what he's saying.'

verses.kjv: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?
verses.decoded: Jesus knew they wanted to ask him about this and said, 'Are you talking among yourselves about what I said, that you won't see me for a little while and then will see me again?'

verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
verses.decoded: I tell you the truth, you will cry and be sad, but the world will be happy. You will be sad, but your sadness will turn into joy.

verses.kjv: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.
verses.decoded: A woman feels pain when she is about to give birth, but after the baby is born, she forgets the pain because she is so happy a new person has come into the world.

verses.kjv: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.
verses.decoded: Right now you are sad, but I will see you again, and your hearts will be full of joy that no one can take away.

verses.kjv: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.
verses.decoded: That day, you won't need to ask me for anything. I tell you the truth, whatever you ask the Father in my name, he will give you.

verses.kjv: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.
verses.decoded: Until now, you haven't asked for anything in my name. Ask, and you will receive so your joy will be complete.

verses.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.
verses.decoded: I have spoken to you in riddles, but the time is coming when I will speak clearly about the Father.

verses.kjv: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:
verses.decoded: On that day, you will ask in my name. I am not telling you that I will pray to the Father for you.

verses.kjv: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.
verses.decoded: The Father loves you because you love me and believe that I came from God.

verses.kjv: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.
verses.decoded: I came from the Father into the world, and now I am leaving the world to go back to the Father.

verses.kjv: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.
verses.decoded: His followers said, 'Now you are speaking clearly and not using riddles.'

verses.kjv: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.
verses.decoded: Now we know you understand everything and don't need anyone to ask you questions. We believe you came from God because of this.

verses.kjv: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?
verses.decoded: Jesus asked them, 'Do you really believe now?'

verses.kjv: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
verses.decoded: The time is coming, and it is already here, when you will all go your own ways and leave me alone. But I am not really alone, because the Father is with me.

verses.kjv: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
verses.decoded: I have told you these things so you can have peace in me. You will have troubles in this world, but be brave; I have defeated the world.

verses.kjv: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:
verses.decoded: Jesus said these words, looked up to heaven, and said, 'Father, the time has come. Please honor your Son, so that the Son can honor you.'

verses.kjv: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.
verses.decoded: You have given him power over everyone, so he can give eternal life to all you have given him.

verses.kjv: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.
verses.decoded: Eternal life means knowing you, the only true God, and knowing Jesus Christ, whom you sent.

verses.kjv: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.
verses.decoded: I have honored you on earth by finishing the work you gave me to do.

verses.kjv: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.
verses.decoded: Now, Father, please honor me with the glory I had with you before the world began.

verses.kjv: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.
verses.decoded: I have shown your name to the people you gave me from the world. They belonged to you, and you gave them to me, and they have obeyed your word.

verses.kjv: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.
verses.decoded: Now they know that everything you gave me comes from you.

verses.kjv: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.
verses.decoded: I gave them the words you gave me, and they accepted them. They know I came from you, and they believe you sent me.

verses.kjv: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.
verses.decoded: I pray for them. I am not praying for the whole world, but for the people you gave me, because they belong to you.

verses.kjv: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.
verses.decoded: All who belong to me belong to you, and all who belong to you belong to me. I am honored because of them.

verses.kjv: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.
verses.decoded: I am no longer in the world, but they are still in the world. I am coming to you, Father. Please protect those you gave me by your name, so they will be united just like we are.

verses.kjv: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.
verses.decoded: While I was with them, I protected them by your name. I kept safe all you gave me, and none of them is lost except the one who was meant to be lost, so the scripture would be fulfilled.

verses.kjv: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.
verses.decoded: Now I am coming to you. I say these things while I am still in the world so they can have my joy completely.

verses.kjv: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
verses.decoded: I gave them your word, and the world hates them because they don’t belong to the world, just like I don’t belong to the world.

verses.kjv: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.
verses.decoded: I am not asking you to take them out of the world, but please protect them from evil.

verses.kjv: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
verses.decoded: They don’t belong to the world, just like I don’t belong to the world.

verses.kjv: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.
verses.decoded: Make them holy by your truth; your word is truth.

verses.kjv: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.
verses.decoded: Just as you sent me into the world, I am sending them into the world too.

verses.kjv: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.
verses.decoded: I am setting myself apart for them, so they can be set apart by the truth.

verses.kjv: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;
verses.decoded: I am not praying only for these people, but also for those who will believe in me because of their message.

verses.kjv: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.
verses.decoded: I pray that all of them will be united, just like you, Father, are in me and I am in you, so they can be united with us, and the world will believe that you sent me.

verses.kjv: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:
verses.decoded: I have given them the glory you gave me, so they can be united just like we are united.

verses.kjv: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.
verses.decoded: I am in them and you are in me, so they can be completely united, and the world will know that you sent me and that you love them just like you love me.

verses.kjv: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.
verses.decoded: Father, I want those you gave me to be with me where I am, so they can see the glory you gave me, because you loved me before the world was made.

verses.kjv: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.
verses.decoded: Righteous Father, the world does not know you, but I know you, and these people know that you sent me.

verses.kjv: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.
verses.decoded: I have told them your name and will keep telling them, so your love for me will be in them, and I will be in them.

verses.kjv: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.
verses.decoded: After Jesus said these things, he and his disciples went across the Kidron Valley to a garden, where Jesus and his disciples often went.

verses.kjv: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.
verses.decoded: Judas, the one who was going to betray Jesus, knew the place because Jesus often went there with his disciples.

verses.kjv: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
verses.decoded: Judas brought a group of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, carrying lanterns, torches, and weapons.

verses.kjv: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?
verses.decoded: Jesus knew everything that was going to happen to him, so he went out and asked them, 'Who are you looking for?'

verses.kjv: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.
verses.decoded: They answered, 'Jesus of Nazareth.' Jesus said, 'I am he.' Judas, the one who betrayed him, was standing with them.

verses.kjv: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
verses.decoded: As soon as Jesus said, 'I am he,' they stepped back and fell to the ground.

verses.kjv: Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.decoded: Jesus asked them again, 'Who are you looking for?' They said, 'Jesus of Nazareth.'

verses.kjv: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:
verses.decoded: Jesus told them, 'I already told you that I am he. If you are looking for me, let these others go.'

verses.kjv: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.
verses.decoded: This happened to fulfill what Jesus had said: 'I have not lost any of the people you gave me.'

verses.kjv: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.
verses.decoded: Then Simon Peter took out a sword and cut off the right ear of the high priest’s servant, whose name was Malchus.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?
verses.decoded: Jesus told Peter, 'Put your sword away. Shouldn’t I drink the cup my Father has given me?'

verses.kjv: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,
verses.decoded: Then the group of soldiers, their captain, and Jewish officers arrested Jesus and tied him up.

verses.kjv: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.
verses.decoded: They took Jesus first to Annas, because he was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year.

verses.kjv: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
verses.decoded: Caiaphas was the one who told the Jewish leaders that it was better for one man to die for the people.

verses.kjv: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.
verses.decoded: Simon Peter followed Jesus, and another disciple who knew the high priest went with Jesus into the high priest’s house.

verses.kjv: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.
verses.decoded: Peter waited outside the door. The other disciple talked to the woman guarding the door and brought Peter inside.

verses.kjv: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man's disciples? He saith, I am not.
verses.decoded: The woman asked Peter, 'Aren't you one of this man’s followers?' Peter said, 'No, I’m not.'

verses.kjv: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.
verses.decoded: The servants and officers were standing around a fire to warm up because it was cold, and Peter stood with them to warm himself.

verses.kjv: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.
verses.decoded: The high priest asked Jesus about his followers and what he was teaching.

verses.kjv: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'I have spoken openly to everyone. I always taught in the synagogue and the temple where the Jews meet. I have never said anything in secret.'

verses.kjv: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'Why do you ask me? Ask the people who heard me. They know what I said.'

verses.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?
verses.decoded: After Jesus said this, one of the officers nearby hit him and said, 'Is that how you answer the high priest?'

verses.kjv: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'If I said something wrong, prove it. But if I spoke the truth, why did you hit me?'

verses.kjv: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.
verses.decoded: Annas sent Jesus, still tied up, to Caiaphas the high priest.

verses.kjv: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.
verses.decoded: Peter was warming himself again when people asked him, 'Aren’t you one of his followers?' He said no.

verses.kjv: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?
verses.decoded: One of the high priest’s servants, whose ear Peter had cut off, said, 'Didn’t I see you with Jesus in the garden?'

verses.kjv: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.
verses.decoded: Peter said again that he was not a follower, and right then the rooster crowed.

verses.kjv: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.
verses.decoded: They took Jesus from Caiaphas to the judgment hall early in the morning. The Jewish leaders did not go inside because they didn’t want to be ceremonially unclean before eating the Passover meal.

verses.kjv: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?
verses.decoded: Pilate came out to them and asked, 'What charges do you bring against this man?'

verses.kjv: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.
verses.decoded: They said, 'If he wasn’t a criminal, we wouldn’t have handed him over to you.'

verses.kjv: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
verses.decoded: Pilate said, 'Take him and judge him by your own law.' The Jewish leaders said, 'We are not allowed to put anyone to death.'

verses.kjv: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.
verses.decoded: This happened so that what Jesus said about how he would die would come true.

verses.kjv: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?
verses.decoded: Pilate went back into the judge's room, called Jesus, and asked, 'Are you the King of the Jews?'

verses.kjv: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?
verses.decoded: Jesus asked him, 'Are you asking this on your own, or did others tell you about me?'

verses.kjv: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?
verses.decoded: Pilate said, 'Am I a Jew? Your own people and the main priests handed you over to me. What have you done?'

verses.kjv: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'My kingdom is not from this world. If it were, my followers would fight to stop me from being handed over. But my kingdom is not from here.'

verses.kjv: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.
verses.decoded: Pilate asked, 'So you are a king?' Jesus said, 'You say I am a king. I was born for this and came into the world to tell the truth. Everyone who belongs to the truth listens to me.'

verses.kjv: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.
verses.decoded: Pilate said, 'What is truth?' After saying this, he went outside to the Jews and told them, 'I find no fault in him.'

verses.kjv: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
verses.decoded: Pilate said, 'You have a custom to let one prisoner go at Passover. Do you want me to release the King of the Jews to you?'

verses.kjv: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.
verses.decoded: They all shouted again, 'Not this man, but Barabbas!' Barabbas was a robber.

verses.kjv: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.
verses.decoded: Then Pilate took Jesus and whipped him.

verses.kjv: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,
verses.decoded: The soldiers made a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and put a purple robe on him.

verses.kjv: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.
verses.decoded: They said, 'Hail, King of the Jews!' and hit him with their hands.

verses.kjv: Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.
verses.decoded: Pilate went out again and said to them, 'Look, I am bringing him out to you so you can see I find no fault in him.'

verses.kjv: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man!
verses.decoded: Jesus came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. Pilate said, 'Look at the man!'

verses.kjv: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Take ye him, and crucify him: for I find no fault in him.
verses.decoded: When the chief priests and officers saw him, they shouted, 'Crucify him! Crucify him!' Pilate said, 'You take him and crucify him yourselves. I find no fault in him.'

verses.kjv: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.
verses.decoded: The Jews said, 'We have a law, and by that law he must die because he claimed to be the Son of God.'

verses.kjv: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;
verses.decoded: When Pilate heard this, he became even more afraid.

verses.kjv: And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.
verses.decoded: He went back into the judge's room and asked Jesus, 'Where are you from?' But Jesus did not answer.

verses.kjv: Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?
verses.decoded: Pilate said, 'Don't you speak to me? Don't you know I have the power to crucify you or to set you free?'

verses.kjv: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'You would have no power over me if it were not given to you from above. So the one who handed me over to you is more guilty.'

verses.kjv: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Caesar's friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar.
verses.decoded: Pilate wanted to let Jesus go, but the Jewish leaders shouted, saying, 'If you let this man go, you are not a friend of Caesar. Anyone who makes himself a king is against Caesar.'

verses.kjv: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.
verses.decoded: When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out and sat down to judge him at a place called the Pavement, which in Hebrew is Gabbatha.

verses.kjv: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!
verses.decoded: It was the day before the Passover, around noon, and Pilate said to the Jews, 'Here is your King!'

verses.kjv: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Caesar.
verses.decoded: But they shouted, 'Take him away! Crucify him!' Pilate asked, 'Should I crucify your King?' The chief priests answered, 'We have no king but Caesar.'

verses.kjv: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.
verses.decoded: So Pilate handed Jesus over to be crucified. The soldiers took Jesus and led him away.

verses.kjv: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:
verses.decoded: Jesus carried his cross and went to a place called the Place of a Skull, which is called Golgotha in Hebrew.

verses.kjv: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.
verses.decoded: There they crucified Jesus, and two others with him, one on each side, with Jesus in the middle.

verses.kjv: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF
verses.decoded: Pilate wrote a sign and put it on the cross. It said, 'Jesus of Nazareth, the King of the Jews.'

verses.kjv: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.
verses.decoded: Many Jews read this sign because the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city, and the sign was written in Hebrew, Greek, and Latin.

verses.kjv: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.
verses.decoded: The chief priests told Pilate, 'Don't write "The King of the Jews," but write that he said, "I am King of the Jews."'

verses.kjv: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.
verses.decoded: Pilate answered, 'What I have written, I have written.'

verses.kjv: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
verses.decoded: After they crucified Jesus, the soldiers took his clothes and divided them into four parts, one part for each soldier. They also took his coat, which was made without seams from top to bottom.

verses.kjv: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.
verses.decoded: They said to each other, 'Let's not tear the coat, but throw dice to see who gets it.' This fulfilled the scripture that says, 'They divided my clothes and cast lots for my garment.' So the soldiers did this.

verses.kjv: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.
verses.decoded: Jesus' mother stood near the cross, along with her sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.

verses.kjv: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!
verses.decoded: When Jesus saw his mother and the disciple he loved standing nearby, he said to his mother, 'Woman, here is your son!'

verses.kjv: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.
verses.decoded: Then he said to the disciple, 'Here is your mother!' From that time, the disciple took her into his home.

verses.kjv: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.
verses.decoded: After this, Jesus knew that everything was finished to fulfill the scripture, and he said, 'I am thirsty.'

verses.kjv: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.
verses.decoded: There was a container full of vinegar. They soaked a sponge in the vinegar, put it on a branch of hyssop, and lifted it to Jesus' mouth.

verses.kjv: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
verses.decoded: After Jesus took the vinegar, he said, 'It is finished.' Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.

verses.kjv: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
verses.decoded: The Jewish leaders asked Pilate to break the legs of those crucified so their bodies would not stay on the crosses during the Sabbath, because that Sabbath was a special day.

verses.kjv: Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.
verses.decoded: The soldiers came and broke the legs of the first man and the other man who was crucified with him.

verses.kjv: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:
verses.decoded: But when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they did not break his legs.

verses.kjv: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.
verses.decoded: Instead, one soldier pierced Jesus' side with a spear, and blood and water came out.

verses.kjv: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.
verses.decoded: The man who saw this told the truth, and his story is true so that you can believe it.

verses.kjv: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.
verses.decoded: This happened to make the scripture come true: not one of his bones would be broken.

verses.kjv: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.
verses.decoded: Another scripture says, 'They will look at the one they pierced.'

verses.kjv: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.
verses.decoded: After this, Joseph of Arimathaea, who was a secret follower of Jesus because he was afraid of the Jews, asked Pilate if he could take Jesus' body. Pilate said yes, so Joseph took Jesus' body.

verses.kjv: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.
verses.decoded: Nicodemus, who had first come to Jesus at night, also came and brought about 100 pounds of a mixture of myrrh and aloes.

verses.kjv: Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.
verses.decoded: They took Jesus' body and wrapped it in linen cloth with the spices, as the Jewish custom for burial.

verses.kjv: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.
verses.decoded: The place where Jesus was crucified had a garden, and in the garden was a new tomb where no one had been buried yet.

verses.kjv: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews' preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.
verses.decoded: They laid Jesus there because it was the day before the Jewish Sabbath, and the tomb was nearby.

verses.kjv: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.
verses.decoded: Early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been moved away.

verses.kjv: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.
verses.decoded: She ran to Simon Peter and the other disciple Jesus loved and told them, 'They have taken the Lord out of the tomb, and we don't know where they put him.'

verses.kjv: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.
verses.decoded: Peter and the other disciple went to the tomb.

verses.kjv: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.
verses.decoded: They both ran, but the other disciple ran faster and reached the tomb first.

verses.kjv: And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.
verses.decoded: He bent down and looked inside and saw the linen cloths lying there, but he did not go in.

verses.kjv: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,
verses.decoded: Then Simon Peter arrived and went into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying there.

verses.kjv: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.
verses.decoded: The cloth that had been around Jesus' head was not lying with the linen cloths but was folded up in a separate place.

verses.kjv: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.
verses.decoded: Then the other disciple who had arrived first went into the tomb, saw everything, and believed.

verses.kjv: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.
verses.decoded: They still did not understand from the scripture that Jesus had to rise from the dead.

verses.kjv: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.
verses.decoded: Then the disciples went back to their own homes.

verses.kjv: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,
verses.decoded: But Mary stood outside the tomb crying. As she cried, she bent down and looked inside the tomb.

verses.kjv: And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
verses.decoded: She saw two angels dressed in white sitting where Jesus' body had been—one at the head and one at the feet.

verses.kjv: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.
verses.decoded: They asked her, 'Woman, why are you crying?' She said, 'Because they took my Lord away, and I don't know where they put him.'

verses.kjv: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.
verses.decoded: After she said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there, but she did not realize it was Jesus.

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.
verses.decoded: Jesus asked her, 'Woman, why are you crying? Who are you looking for?' She thought he was the gardener and said, 'Sir, if you carried him away, please tell me where you put him so I can get him.'

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to her, 'Mary.' She turned to him and said, 'Rabboni,' which means 'Teacher.'

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'Don't touch me, because I haven't yet gone to my Father. But go to my brothers and tell them, I am going to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.'

verses.kjv: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had spoken these things unto her.
verses.decoded: Mary Magdalene went and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord and that he had said these things to her.

verses.kjv: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
verses.decoded: That same evening, the first day of the week, the disciples were together with the doors locked because they were afraid of the Jews. Jesus came and stood among them and said, 'Peace be with you.'

verses.kjv: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.
verses.decoded: After he said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples were happy when they saw the Lord.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to them again, 'Peace be with you. Just as my Father sent me, I am sending you.'

verses.kjv: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:
verses.decoded: After he said this, he breathed on them and said, 'Receive the Holy Spirit.'

verses.kjv: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.
verses.decoded: If you forgive anyone's sins, they are forgiven. If you don't forgive them, their sins are not forgiven.

verses.kjv: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.
verses.decoded: But Thomas, one of the twelve disciples, was not with them when Jesus came.

verses.kjv: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.
verses.decoded: The other disciples told him, 'We have seen the Lord.' But Thomas said, 'Unless I see the nail marks in his hands and put my finger where the nails were, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.'

verses.kjv: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.
verses.decoded: Eight days later, the disciples were together again, and Thomas was with them. Even though the doors were locked, Jesus came and stood among them and said, 'Peace be with you.'

verses.kjv: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.
verses.decoded: Then Jesus said to Thomas, 'Put your finger here and look at my hands. Put your hand into my side. Don't be unbelieving; believe.'

verses.kjv: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.
verses.decoded: Thomas answered him, 'My Lord and my God!'

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to him, 'Because you have seen me, you believe. Blessed are those who have not seen me but still believe.'

verses.kjv: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:
verses.decoded: Jesus did many other miracles in front of his followers, but they are not all written down in this book.

verses.kjv: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.
verses.decoded: These things are written so that you may believe Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God, and by believing, you can have life through his name.

verses.kjv: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.
verses.decoded: After these events, Jesus appeared again to his followers by the Sea of Tiberias, showing himself in this way.

verses.kjv: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.
verses.decoded: Simon Peter, Thomas (called Didymus), Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples were together.

verses.kjv: Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with thee. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.
verses.decoded: Simon Peter said, 'I'm going fishing.' The others said, 'We will go with you.' They went out in a boat but caught nothing that night.

verses.kjv: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.
verses.decoded: Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not realize it was him.

verses.kjv: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.
verses.decoded: Jesus asked them, 'Children, do you have any food?' They answered, 'No.'

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.
verses.decoded: He told them to throw the net on the right side of the boat, and when they did, they caught so many fish they could hardly pull the net in.

verses.kjv: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher's coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.
verses.decoded: The disciple Jesus loved told Peter, 'It is the Lord!' When Peter heard this, he quickly put on his coat because he was naked and jumped into the sea.

verses.kjv: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.
verses.decoded: The other disciples came in a small boat, about 200 cubits from land, pulling the net full of fish.

verses.kjv: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
verses.decoded: When they reached the shore, they saw a fire with coals, fish on it, and some bread.

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.
verses.decoded: Jesus told them to bring some of the fish they had just caught.

verses.kjv: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.
verses.decoded: Simon Peter pulled the net to shore, and it was full of 153 large fish, but the net did not break.

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'Come and eat.' None of the disciples dared to ask who he was because they knew it was the Lord.

verses.kjv: Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.
verses.decoded: Jesus came, took the bread, gave it to them, and did the same with the fish.

verses.kjv: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.
verses.decoded: This was the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he rose from the dead.

verses.kjv: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.
verses.decoded: After they ate, Jesus asked Simon Peter, 'Simon, son of Jonas, do you love me more than these others do?' Peter said, 'Yes, Lord, you know I love you.' Jesus said, 'Take care of my lambs.'

verses.kjv: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
verses.decoded: Jesus asked again, 'Simon, son of Jonas, do you love me?' Peter said, 'Yes, Lord, you know I love you.' Jesus said, 'Take care of my sheep.'

verses.kjv: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
verses.decoded: Jesus asked a third time, 'Simon, son of Jonas, do you love me?' Peter was sad that Jesus asked three times and said, 'Lord, you know everything; you know I love you.' Jesus said, 'Take care of my sheep.'

verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.
verses.decoded: I tell you the truth, when you were young, you dressed yourself and went where you wanted. But when you are old, others will put a belt on you and take you where you do not want to go.

verses.kjv: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.
verses.decoded: Jesus said this to show how Peter would die and honor God. After saying this, Jesus told him, 'Follow me.'

verses.kjv: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?
verses.decoded: Peter turned around and saw the disciple Jesus loved following them. This disciple was the one who leaned on Jesus' chest at dinner and asked, 'Lord, who will betray you?'

verses.kjv: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?
verses.decoded: Peter saw this and asked Jesus, 'Lord, what will happen to this man?'

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'If I want him to live until I come back, what does that have to do with you? You follow me.'

verses.kjv: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?
verses.decoded: This story spread among the followers that this disciple would not die. But Jesus never said he wouldn't die; he said, 'If I want him to live until I come back, what does that have to do with you?'

verses.kjv: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.
verses.decoded: This is the disciple who tells about these things and wrote them down. We know his story is true.

verses.kjv: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.
verses.decoded: Jesus did many other things too. If all of them were written down, I think the whole world couldn't hold all the books that would be written. Amen.
